facts: FulfillmentStart and FulfillmentEnd: append-only unique phase observations
FulfillmentReplacement: same-set forward-ordinal terminal predecessor link
operations: Create immutable fulfillment and list by intent set
Record same-set terminal replacement; preserve prior outcome
Fulfillments.enqueueTask: authorized durable link plus resumable real WorkQueue enqueue
invariants: Domain owns request payload, partial quantities, business status and typed outcome satellites
Terminal observation is unique and wins over late start reports; cancellation does not promise physical work has stopped
Completed/failed fulfillment requires matching start and valid timing; complete/partial coverage is explicit
Replacement stays within one intent set and moves forward by immutable ordinal, preventing cycles
Execution task retry/failure/cancellation/completion does not automatically mutate business phase
Queue link persistence and enqueue form a resumable two-step bridge, not a cross-service transaction
